title: SecB Fail-Learn Classification Taxonomy (WP1 deliverable 2)
description: Schema for the versioned, closed registry that classifies failure_class values (SECB-FAIL-LEARN-001 section 5). This registry is the single source of truth for which classes are positive-control evidence (a correctly denied request is NOT a control malfunction, section 5 final sentence) and which require security-event routing. The filled-in canonical instance lives at data/classification-taxonomy.instance.json. Cross-document use: semantic-validator.mjs loads this instance (not a per-vector-supplied copy) to resolve failure_class -> is_positive_control when checking a Failure Evidence Envelope's decision/failure consistency (SCEN-01).

closed.description: MUST be true. This taxonomy is closed -- entries.failure_class values are drawn from common.schema.json#/$defs/failure_class and no free-text failure classes are permitted anywhere in this contract set.

category.description: Coarse grouping, aligned to the informal v0.1 docs/templates/failure-evidence-envelope.yaml classification prefixes (F-AUTH/F-TECH/F-DEP/F-EVID/F-QUAL/F-SEC/F-OPS/F-OUT/F-KNOW/F-SKILL), so this formal taxonomy is traceable to the pre-existing informal template rather than silently orphaning it.

is_positive_control.description: True only for classes that represent a correctly-working control (denial-as-designed or a passed negative test), never a malfunction.

allOf.description: Positive-control classes never route as a security event by default.
